root_cause: The Build / Build job failed on two consecutive artifact upload steps: 'Upload OpenVINO developer package' and 'Upload OpenVINO tests package'. All preceding build/compilation steps succeeded. The pattern is consistent with a transient GitHub Actions artifact storage service issue (network error, 403 Forbidden from blob storage, or ECONNREFUSED), which has been observed multiple times in this repository for similar artifact upload failures in Build jobs. No PR is associated with this merge-group run.

recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Build / Build job to attempt a fresh artifact upload
If failure persists, check GitHub Actions artifact service status
If the PR was dropped from the merge queue, re-add it after confirming the artifact service is healthy
prevention_strategies: Artifact upload failures of this type are transient infrastructure issues. Adding retry logic to artifact upload steps can reduce the impact of transient failures.
historical_context: Similar artifact upload failures have been observed in multiple prior investigations: RISC-V builds with FinalizeArtifact 403 (patterns 602c52a223d7ebfe), Windows builds with silent upload failures (pattern 89059626d1cbf7b3), and debian package upload failures (pattern edfaf9946abc4dee).
